help.pages.analysis.field.document: Sifatni ta'minlash spetsifikatsiyasi matni test stsenariysi jadvallari bilan.
help.pages.analysis.field.project: Baseline source used for document-vs-code comparison.
help.pages.analysis.fields:
Project|Baseline source to compare against
Spec document|Quality assurance specification text
Reconciliation ID|Reference number for triggering a run after a decision
help.pages.analysis.steps:
Solishtirish konteksti uchun loyihani tanlang.
Spetsifikatsiya matnini joylashtiring — kamida 50 belgi va test stsenariysi jadvallari.
Spetsifikatsiya–kod solishtiruvini ishga tushiring va taklif etilgan tekshiruv qadamlarini o'qing.
Mos kelsa, test stsenariysi yaratishni davom eting; farq bo'lsa, tuzatish ro'yxatini rivojlantirishga yuboring.
help.pages.analysis.summary: Yozilgan spetsifikatsiyani koddan olingan bazaviy chiziq bilan solishtiradi. Natija keyingi qadamni koʻrsatadi.
help.pages.analysis.title: Spetsifikatsiya–kod solishtiruvi
help.pages.analysisDocs.fields:
Loyiha|Tahlilini ko'rayotgan ilova
Versiya|Kod skanerining saqlangan surati
Eksport|Portal tilingizda Markdown yoki PDF
help.pages.analysisDocs.steps:
Loyiha va ulangan repozitoriyani tanlang.
Operator xulosasini ko'rib chiqing: versiya o'zgarishlari, maydon nomuvofiqliklari va kritik oqimlar.
Manfaatdorlar uchun PDF yoki Markdown yuklab oling.
Modul spec relizga tayyor bo'lmasa, tashqi ulashishdan oldin sifat bo'shliqlarini bartaraf eting.
help.pages.analysisDocs.summary: Kod skaneridan o'qiladigan tahlil — versiya tarixi, bo'shliqlar va tilingizda eksport.
help.pages.analysisDocs.title: Tahlil hujjatlari
help.pages.bi.steps:
Avval kompaniya ma'lumotlar bazasini ulang.
Sxemani o'rganing va sxema ko'rgichida oson bog'lanishlar hamda ustun tafsilotlarini ko'ring.
Chatda savol bering — masalan, oylik savdo yoki eng ko'p sotilgan mahsulotlar.
Kerakli vaqtda hisobot e-pochtalarini rejalashtirishingiz mumkin.
help.pages.bi.summary: Dynamic analytics dashboard over your company data. Ask in chat; charts and tables update instantly.
help.pages.bi.title: Business Intelligence
help.pages.biAlerts.steps:
Create an alert — enter title, metric to watch, threshold, and recipient email.
Use Check alerts now to evaluate all active rules immediately.
Pause or resume without deleting.
help.pages.biAlerts.summary: Email notification when a metric crosses the threshold you set.
help.pages.biAlerts.title: Threshold alerts
help.pages.biAnalytics.steps:
Ask in plain language: list dashboards, create a chart, show a board, or delete a chart.
Pick a board from the sidebar or let the assistant open one for you.
The interface language follows your portal language setting.
help.pages.biAnalytics.summary: Create, list, view, and delete dashboards, charts, and datasets via chat.
help.pages.biAnalytics.title: AI-powered analytics
help.pages.biAudit.steps:
Review recent entries for compliance.
Failed rows show error details.
Retention period is set by your administrator.
help.pages.biAudit.summary: Read-only log of data queries, exports, and chat actions.
help.pages.biAudit.title: Reports audit log
help.pages.biChat.steps:
Pick a session from the sidebar or start a new one.
Ask in plain language — the linked dashboard updates.
Use voice input on supported browsers.
help.pages.biChat.summary: Analyst mode with session history, streaming replies, and voice input.
help.pages.biChat.title: Full-screen reports chat
help.pages.biConnection.fields:
Deployment|On-premise or cloud environment
Connection type|Enterprise or cloud database
Access key|Key from your cloud admin panel
help.pages.biConnection.steps:
Shablon tanlang yoki host, port va bazani kiriting.
Ulanishni sinab ko'ring — saqlashdan oldin muvaffaqiyatli bo'lishi kerak.
Saqlang va faollashtiring — keyin jadvallar va bog'lanishlar uchun sxema ko'rgichini oching.
help.pages.biConnection.summary: Configure enterprise or cloud databases. Credentials are stored on the server only.
help.pages.biConnection.title: Database Connection
help.pages.biGlossary.steps:
Click Add term; enter table, optional column, business name, and definition.
Edit existing rows from the actions column.
Terms are sent to the assistant as context on every chat request.
help.pages.biGlossary.summary: Map table and column names to business terms so the assistant produces accurate queries.
help.pages.biGlossary.title: Business glossary
help.pages.biQueries.steps:
Save queries from chat or the widget menu.
Click Run to preview results.
Pin to dashboard adds a table widget to the active board.
Export downloads the results.
help.pages.biQueries.summary: Queries saved from chat or widgets — re-run, export, or pin to a dashboard.
help.pages.biQueries.title: Saved queries
help.pages.biReports.steps:
Create a report from chat: "save this as weekly sales report".
Open a report to view its widgets.
Delete outdated reports from the actions column.
help.pages.biReports.summary: Saved custom report layouts created from chat.
help.pages.biReports.title: AI Reports
help.pages.biSchedules.steps:
Create schedules from chat: "send me an email tomorrow morning".
The server sends due emails on a regular schedule.
Use Send due emails now for a manual trigger.
help.pages.biSchedules.summary: Report emails sent automatically at the time you specify.
help.pages.biSchedules.title: Email Schedules
help.pages.biSchema.fields:
Oson bog'lanishlar|Jadvallar bir-biriga qanday havola qilishini ko'rsatadigan kartalar
Jadvallar va ustunlar|Ustun tartibi, ma'lumot turlari, PK/FK

help.pages.biSchema.steps:
Ma'lumotlar bazasini ulang, keyin «Sxemani o'rganish» tugmasini bosing.
«Oson bog'lanishlar» yorlig'ida jadvallar qanday bog'langanini ko'ring.
«Jadvallar va ustunlar» yorlig'ida ma'lumot turlari va tartibini tekshiring.
Production sxemasi o'zgarganda qayta ishga tushiring.
help.pages.biSchema.summary: Bazadan jadvallar, ustunlar va bog'lanishlar — operator uchun oddiy kartalar, muhandis uchun texnik ER graf.
help.pages.biSchema.title: Ma'lumotlar bazasi sxemasi
help.pages.biShares.steps:
Faol doska uchun ulashish yarating.
Ichki havolani nusxalang — belgilangan muddatdan keyin tugaydi.
Kerak bo‘lmasa jadvaldan bekor qiling.
help.pages.biShares.summary: Kompaniya ichida hamkasblar va rahbariyat uchun muddatli faqat o‘qish havolalari.
help.pages.biShares.title: Jamoa doska ulashishi
help.pages.biTemplates.steps:
Browse templates by category: query, dashboard widget, or schedule.
Ask in chat sends the ready prompt to the reports assistant.
Add to dashboard runs the query and pins a widget on the active board.
Create starter dashboard loads the default insurance KPI set.
help.pages.biTemplates.summary: Insurance domain prompt library — start a chat question or add dashboard widgets from curated templates.
help.pages.biTemplates.title: Query templates
help.pages.dashboard.steps:
Yuqori panelda tizim, sayt va xizmat ulanishlari yashil ekanini tekshiring.
Tasdiq kutilayotgan stsenariylarni koʻrib chiqing — muhim ustuvorlikdagilari testni toʻxtatishi mumkin.
Oxirgi ishga tushirish yonidagi strelkani bosib tafsilotlarni oching.
Oxirgi xatolar boʻlimidan muvaffaqiyatsiz testlarni tekshiring.
help.pages.dashboard.summary: Test jarayoningizning joriy koʻrinishi: katalog hajmi, tasdiq kutilayotganlar, navbat, oxirgi ishga tushirishlar va xatolar.
help.pages.dashboard.title: Dashboard
help.pages.enterprise.steps:
Integratsiya holatini tekshiring — Jira, Vault, MinIO va navbat.
Loyiha bo‘yicha release gate va rejalashtirilgan hisobotlarni sozlang.
Mijoz demo oldidan audit va compliance yorliqlaridan foydalaning.
help.pages.enterprise.summary: Enterprise boshqaruvi: integratsiyalar, vault sirlar, compliance eksport va platforma operatsiyalari.
help.pages.enterprise.title: Enterprise markaz

Ishga tushirish roʻyxatidan vazifa havolasi orqali oching.
Batafsil yozuv faylini yuklab tekshiring.
Vizual farqlarni koʻrib chiqing; ataylab UI oʻzgargan boʻlsa, Test katalogida bazaviy chiziqni tasdiqlang.
Skanerlash yoqilgan boʻlsa, qulaylik buzilishlari jadvalini tekshiring.

help.pages.login.steps:
Email va parolingizni kiriting.
Kerak bo'lsa, sarlavhadan portal tilini tanlang.
Kirishdan so'ng bosh sahifadan Test yoki BI modulini oching.
help.pages.login.summary: QA, administrator yoki dasturchi rollari uchun portal kirishi.
help.pages.login.title: Kirish

help.pages.process.steps:
Avval loyiha va muhit sozlamasini yakunlang.
Kod skanerini ishga tushiring va tahlil hujjatlarini ko'rib chiqing.
Spec va kodni solishtiring hamda katalogda P0 stsenariylarni tasdiqlang.
Testlarni yarating va ishga tushiring, so'ng natijalar va hisobotlarni tekshiring.
help.pages.process.summary: Kod skaneri, solishtirish, katalog tasdiqi, yaratish va ishga tushirish — qadamlarni ketma-ket bajaring.
help.pages.process.title: Test jarayoni markazi

Loyiha qoʻshishni bosing; loyiha identifikatori, nom, ombor manzili va asosiy manzilni toʻldiring.

Manba identifikatorini tanlang — odatda loyiha identifikatori bilan bir xil.
Tasdiq kutilayotgan muhim stsenariylarni belgilang.
Tanlanganlarni tasdiqlang — testlar navbatga qoʻshiladi.
Jarayon tugagach, oxirgi ishga tushirish holatini tekshiring.

Jonli jarayon, jurnallar va artefaktlar uchun Test ishga tushirishlarini oching.
Suite MD/PDF eksporti uchun Hisobotlar yorlig'ini oching.
Skaner xulosalari uchun Tahlil hujjatlari yorlig'idan foydalaning.
Reliz banneri qizil bo'lsa, sifat xaritasidan nima tuzatish kerakligini ko'ring.

help.pages.reports.steps:
Ishga tushirish identifikatori boʻyicha yozuvni toping.
Izlanish uchun matn hisobotini yuklab oling.
Rahbariyat koʻrib chiqishi uchun PDF yuklab oling.
help.pages.reports.summary: Oxirgi test ishga tushirishlarining matn va PDF hisobotlariga tezkor kirish.

help.pages.qualityMap.steps:
Sifat daraxtini cheklash uchun loyihani tanlang.
Test qamrovi yetishmovchiligi uchun issiqlik xaritasi va explorer ko'rinishlarini ko'rib chiqing.
Entity kalitlaridan scoped suite ishga tushirish uchun aqlli tanlovdan foydalaning.
Regressiya tierlaridan oldin release gate tayyorgarligini tekshiring.
help.pages.qualityMap.summary: Menyu → ekran → API sifat daraxti, heatmap, kuzatuvchanlik va release gate bir joyda.

help.pages.repos.steps:
Ombor manzilini joylashtiring va klonlash orqali saqlang.
Roʻyxatda ombor identifikatori paydo boʻlishini kuting.
Kod tekshiruv natijasini koʻring.
Chuqur bilim skaneri formalar, maʼlumotlar bazasi va xizmatlarni xaritalaydi.
Forma testlarini yarating.
Maxsus spetsifikatsiya boʻlsa, natijani Boʻshliq tahliliga nusxalang.
help.pages.repos.summary: Manba kodi roʻyxati va tekshiruvi — sahifalar, menyular va xizmatlar Boʻshliq tahlili uchun asos boʻladi.

help.pages.run.field.a11y_dedicated_pass: When enabled, accessibility runs as a separate pass instead of embedded in interface tests.
help.pages.run.field.auto_tier: Test scope is chosen automatically based on code changes, risk, and first-run status.
help.pages.run.field.browsers: Multiple browsers can be selected. Each browser runs as a separate job.
help.pages.run.field.enforce_parity: Muhim testlarda qamrov yoki tasdiq yetishmasa ishga tushirishni to'xtatadi — avval test qilinmagan sohalarni solishtirish va katalogda bartaraf eting.
help.pages.run.field.force_regenerate: Keshni e'tiborsiz qoldiring; barcha stsenariylarni qayta yarating.
help.pages.run.field.healing_enabled: Xato bo'lganda avtomatik tuzatish qo'llaydi va bir marta qayta urinadi.
help.pages.run.field.include_a11y: Accessibility scan after each test; violations appear in job detail.
help.pages.run.field.include_api: Run backend service tests alongside interface tests.
help.pages.run.field.include_db: Run database structure checks (TC-DB) when a test database profile is configured; safely skipped otherwise.
help.pages.run.field.include_performance: Adds a separate performance pass. Measurement is quick or detailed depending on scope.
help.pages.run.field.include_visual: Page images are captured and compared to approved baselines.
help.pages.run.field.performance_mode: Automatic, quick, or detailed performance measurement.
help.pages.run.field.playwright_retries: Retries per scenario. Higher values reduce flaky noise but lengthen runs.
help.pages.run.field.project: Must be registered in Projects. Sets repository address and defaults.
help.pages.run.field.tier: Quick, changed-only, wide, or full scope options.
help.pages.run.field.wait: Keeps this page blocked until the full run finishes (up to ~20 min). By default, live progress opens on the run detail screen.
help.pages.run.fields:
Project|Must exist in Projects registry
Scope tier|Quick, changed-only, wide, or full
Include service tests|Backend service tests alongside interface tests
Wait for completion|Wait until finished
Force regenerate|Regenerate all scenarios
help.pages.run.steps:
Muhit saqlangan va sogʻliq tekshiruvi muvaffaqiyatli boʻlsin.
Loyiha va qamrov darajasini tanlang — birinchi ishga tushirish uchun tez qamrov tavsiya etiladi.
Interfeys va server birga tekshirilsa, xizmat testlarini yoqing.
Test jarayonini boshlang — kutish yoqilgan boʻlsa, ishga tushirish tafsilotiga yoʻnaltirilasiz.
Kerak boʻlsa, Test katalogida muhim stsenariylarni tasdiqlang.
help.pages.run.summary: Toʻliq test jarayoni: kod yuklash, tekshirish, stsenariy yaratish, avtomatik ishga tushirish va hisobot.
help.pages.run.title: Testlarni ishga tushirish
